definition_zh: n. 复制；重复；副本；（生物）重复段
definition_en: the act of making an exact copy, a needless repeat of work, or a thing produced as a second copy
core_image: 复印机连续吐出同一页纸，纸盘里叠成一模一样的一摞；同一间办公室两面墙上贴着同一张进度表，各由一个队伍更新；档案柜里正本与副本并放，副本角上盖着「复制」章
scene: 复印机连续吐出同一页纸，纸盘里叠成一模一样的一摞，连页边的订书钉孔都对齐。The duplication of the file took only a minute.
sceneCN: 这里 duplication 指「制作与某物完全一样的副本这一行为」（第 1 个义项：复制）；句意是复制这份文件只花了一分钟。图中可辨识物件：复印机、一模一样的一摞纸、对齐的订书钉孔。

pos.zh: 复制；重复；副本；（生物）重复段

forms.label: 复数（多份副本／多次重复）

senses.title: Making a copy
senses.definition: the act of making an exact copy of something
senses.definitionCN: （名词）制作与某物完全一样的副本这一行为
senses.example: The duplication of the file took only a minute.
senses.exampleCN: 复制这份文件只花了一分钟。
senses.why: A copier keeps handing out the same page until the tray holds one identical stack.
senses.whyCN: 复印机不停吐出同一页，直到纸盘里叠成一模一样的一摞。

senses.title: A needless repeat
senses.definition: the act of doing something again so that effort or material is wasted
senses.definitionCN: （名词）把某事再做一遍，致使人手或材料白费
senses.example: Two departments ran the same survey, a duplication of effort nobody had planned.
senses.exampleCN: 两个部门做了同一项调查，这是谁也没安排过的重复劳动。
senses.why: Two walls in one office carry the same progress chart, each updated by a different team.
senses.whyCN: 同一间办公室的两面墙上贴着同一张进度表，各由一个队伍更新。

senses.title: A second copy
senses.definition: a thing produced as an exact copy of another
senses.definitionCN: （名词）作为另一物的完全复制品而产生的东西
senses.example: The archive keeps a duplication of every signed contract in a separate room.
senses.exampleCN: 档案馆在另一个房间保存着每份已签合同的副本。
senses.why: A cabinet holds the original and its copy, the copy stamped in one corner.
senses.whyCN: 档案柜里放着正本与副本，副本角上盖着一个章。

intro.en: Duplication is the noun of duplicare, to fold twice: the ending -ation turns the folding into an act, so duplication is either the making of a second copy or the copy that results.
intro.cn: duplication 是 duplicare「折两次」的名词：-ation 把折叠变成一个行为，所以 duplication 既指做出第二份的动作，也指由此产生的那一份。

items.en: Latin duo means two.
items.cn: 拉丁语 duo 意为二。

items.en: Latin plicare means to fold.
items.cn: 拉丁语 plicare 意为折叠。

items.en: Latin duplicare means to double or to fold twice.
items.cn: 拉丁语 duplicare 意为加倍或折两次。

items.en: Latin duplicatio names the act of doubling.
items.cn: 拉丁语 duplicatio 指加倍这一行为。

items.en: English duplication is borrowed for the making of a second copy.
items.cn: 英语 duplication 被借入，指做出第二份。

items.en: The word covers copying, wasted repetition and repeated segments in genes or data.
items.cn: 这个词涵盖复制、白费的重复，以及基因或数据中的重复段。

note.en: Duplication shares its long ending with publication and application, while its neighbours name copying, repeating and having more than is needed.
note.cn: duplication 与 publication、application 共用长词尾，而它的近义词则指复制、重复与多余。

entries.definition: the act of producing something exactly like another

entries.definition: the act of doing or saying something again

entries.definition: the state of being more than is needed, or of being no longer useful

dict_mnemonic.text: duplication ＝ duplicate（复制）＋ -ation（行为名词后缀）＝「折成两份这件事」。拉丁语 duo（二）＋ plicare（折叠）→ duplicare「折两次」。三个用法要分清：duplication of the file 是「复制文件」（有用），duplication of effort 是「重复劳动」（白费），gene duplication 是「基因重复」（演化的原料）。avoid duplication 是公文里最常见的「避免重复」。别和 duplicity（两面派）混。

root: 拉丁语 duo（二）＋ plicare（折叠）→ duplicare（折两次）→ duplicatio → 英语 duplication（复制；重复）

intro.cn: duplication 由 du- 加 plic- 加 -ation 组成；-ive 造出 duplicative，而 re- 指称「再」，redund- 指称溢出所需。

latinIntro.en: Latin plicare means to fold, duplicare to double, copia abundance and redundare to overflow.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 plicare 意为折叠，duplicare 意为加倍，copia 意为丰富，redundare 意为溢出。

definition_zh: 耐用的；持久的；耐久的
definition_en: able to last a long time without breaking or wearing out, or continuing for a long time without fading
core_image: 一双走过泥地与碎石、鞋底却仍未开裂的旧靴
scene: 那双旧靴子走过泥地和碎石，鞋底边缘只是磨白了一点。These boots are durable enough for daily work.
sceneCN: 这里 durable 是「耐用的」（第 1 个义项：经得起长期使用而不损坏）；句意是这双靴子足够耐用，适合日常干活。

senses.title: Able to last without breaking
senses.definition: made to last a long time and to resist wear, pressure or damage
senses.definitionCN: 经得起长时间使用，能抵抗磨损、压力或损坏
senses.example: These boots are durable enough for daily work.
senses.exampleCN: 这双靴子足够耐用，适合日常干活。
senses.why: Latin durare meant to last, so durable describes an object that keeps its shape under use.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 durare 意为「持续」，所以 durable 形容一件在反复使用中仍能保持原形的物品。

senses.title: Continuing for a long time
senses.definition: lasting a long time without fading, weakening or ending, as a peace or a relationship
senses.definitionCN: 长时间持续而不消退、不减弱、不终结，如和平或关系
senses.example: The two countries signed a durable peace agreement.
senses.exampleCN: 两国签署了一份持久的和平协议。
senses.why: The same 'lasting' quality is applied to agreements and feelings, where what must resist wear is time rather than friction.
senses.whyCN: 同一种「耐久」品质被用到协议与感情上，那里要抵抗磨损的不是摩擦，而是时间。

senses.title: Goods that last, in economics
senses.definition: used of goods, such as cars or washing machines, that are expected to be used for several years
senses.definitionCN: 用于汽车、洗衣机等预期可使用数年的商品
senses.example: Durable goods such as washing machines are taxed differently.
senses.exampleCN: 洗衣机等耐用品的征税方式有所不同。
senses.why: Economists needed a label for goods that survive many uses, and the adjective became a fixed category.
senses.whyCN: 经济学家需要给能经受多次使用的商品一个标签，这个形容词于是成了固定类别。

intro.en: Durable comes from Latin durare, to last, through Old French; the whole family also gives duration and endure.
intro.cn: durable 经由古法语来自拉丁语 durare（持续），同一词族还给出 duration 与 endure。

items.en: Latin durus meant hard, firm or tough, and it is the adjective behind the whole family.
items.cn: 拉丁语 durus 意为「坚硬的、结实的」，是整个词族背后的形容词。

items.en: The verb durare meant to last, to endure or to remain hard, and it supplied the idea of continuing through time.
items.cn: 动词 durare 意为「持续、忍耐、保持坚硬」，提供了「贯穿时间而延续」的观念。

items.en: The adjective durabilis meant lasting or durable and passed into French as durable.
items.cn: 形容词 durabilis 意为「持久的、耐久的」，后来进入法语作 durable。

items.en: Old French durable carried the sense of lasting and resisting wear into English.
items.cn: 古法语 durable 把「持久、抗磨损」的含义带进了英语。

items.en: Middle English durable was used for materials and for promises that were meant to hold.
items.cn: 中古英语 durable 用于材料，也用于本当守住的承诺。

items.en: Economics fixed durable goods as a category, while ordinary speech kept durable for anything that survives hard use.
items.cn: 经济学把 durable goods 固定为类别，日常语言则用 durable 形容任何经得起折腾的东西。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same Latin lasting family; the near-meaning group separates lasting, sturdy and tough by what they resist.
note.cn: 形近组收同一拉丁「持续」词族的词；近义组按所抵抗的对象区分 lasting、sturdy 与 tough。

entries.definition: The quality of lasting or resisting wear; durable plus -ity.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「耐久性、耐用性」，由 durable 加 -ity 构成。

entries.definition: In a lasting or durable manner; durable plus -ly.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「耐久地、持久地」，由 durable 加 -ly 构成。

entries.definition: The length of time something continues; from Latin durare.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「持续时间、时长」，来自拉丁语 durare。

entries.definition: To suffer something or to last through it; from Latin indurare, related to durus.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「忍受、持续」，来自与 durus 相关的拉丁语 indurare。

entries.definition: Continuing for a long time; close to durable but with less emphasis on resistance to wear.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「持久的」，接近 durable，但较少强调抗磨损。

entries.definition: Strong and solidly built; it stresses resistance to force more than length of use.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「结实的」，更强调抗外力而非使用年限。

entries.definition: Not easily broken or damaged; broader and more informal than durable.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「坚韧的」，比 durable 更宽泛、更口语。

entries.definition: Able to recover shape or strength after pressure; it stresses bounce-back, not just survival.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「有弹性的、能恢复的」，强调受压迫后回弹，而不只是撑住。

normalIntro.en: These hooks connect Latin durare, to last, with boots, peace treaties and durable goods.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子把拉丁语 durare（持续）与靴子、和平协议和耐用品连在一起。

normal.en: Latin durare is to last, so durable means able to keep going.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 durare 是「持续」，所以 durable 就是「能一直撑下去」。

normal.en: Durability is the noun, durably the adverb: the family keeps the same idea.
normal.cn: durability 是名词，durably 是副词，这一族保留同一个观念。

normal.en: The same root gives duration, which is time lasting, and endure, which is lasting through hardship.
normal.cn: 同一词根给出 duration（持续的时间）与 endure（熬过艰难而持续）。

normal.en: A durable boot survives mud; a durable peace survives years.
normal.cn: 耐用的靴子熬过泥泞，持久的和平熬过岁月。

normal.en: Durable goods are things a household expects to keep for years, not weeks.
normal.cn: 耐用品是家庭预期会用上几年而不是几周的东西。

abstract.en: Picture a boot sole that has crossed the same gravel for ten years and still holds its shape.
abstract.cn: 想象一只鞋底在同一片碎石上走了十年，仍然保持原形。

abstract.en: Draw the same line under a peace treaty: the paper is thin, but the agreement does not wear through.
abstract.cn: 把同一条线画在一份和平协议下：纸很薄，协议却没有被磨穿。

abstract.en: Durable is about time failing to break something, whether it is leather, metal or a promise.
abstract.cn: durable 讲的是时间没能弄坏某物，无论那是皮革、金属还是一个承诺。

examples.en: These boots are durable enough for daily work.
examples.cn: 这双靴子足够耐用，适合日常干活。

examples.en: The two countries signed a durable peace agreement.
examples.cn: 两国签署了一份持久的和平协议。

examples.en: Durable goods such as washing machines are taxed differently.
examples.cn: 洗衣机等耐用品的征税方式有所不同。

dict_mnemonic.text: dur- 是「坚硬、持续」：durable 是经得住用的，duration 是持续的时间，endure 是熬得住。

root: 经由古法语 durable 来自拉丁语 durabilis，后者由 durare「持续、忍耐」加 -abilis 构成；durare 又源于 durus「坚硬的、结实的」。同一词根还给出 duration、endure、durability。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses of durable apply one idea of lasting to an object, to an agreement, and to a category of goods.
sensesIntro.cn: durable 的三个义项把同一个「持久」观念分别用到物品、协议和一类商品上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a worn boot whose sole still holds together after years of gravel.
core.cn: 核心意象：一双磨旧的靴子，鞋底在多年碎石之后仍然完好。

branches.en: THE OBJECT: a material or product that resists wear and pressure.
branches.cn: 物品线：抵抗磨损与压力的材料或产品。

branches.en: THE BOND: an agreement or relationship that time does not wear through.
branches.cn: 纽带线：时间磨不穿的协议或关系。

branches.en: THE MARKET: a class of goods expected to serve for years.
branches.cn: 市场线：预期能使用多年的一类商品。

branches.en: TWO KINDS OF WEAR: leather resists friction, while a promise resists time.
branches.cn: 两种磨损：皮革抵抗摩擦，承诺抵抗时间。

branches.en: THE LONG USE: durability is what turns an object into a long-term purchase.
branches.cn: 长期使用线：耐久性使一件物品成为长期投资。

intro.en: Durable is a Latin-derived adjective built from a verb root plus -able; English adds -ity and -ly.
intro.cn: durable 是源自拉丁语的形容词，由动词词根加 -able 构成；英语再加 -ity 与 -ly。

latinIntro.en: Latin durus, durare and durabilis are all recorded, so only the deeper Indo-European root is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 durus、durare、durabilis 均有记录，只有更早的印欧语词根属于重构。

items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供「抵抗」的观念。

items.example: It is the adjective behind the family.
items.exampleCN: 它是这一词族背后的形容词。

items.meaning: able to be or to do

definition_zh: 持续时间；期间；音长
definition_en: the length of time that something continues, the period during which it happens, or the length of a sound
core_image: 一只沙漏，沙粒从上格漏到下格，量出一段有多长
scene: 手术室外的走廊里，家属盯着墙上的钟，秒针一圈圈过去。The duration of the operation was about four hours.
sceneCN: 这里 duration 是「持续时间」（第 1 个义项：某事从开始到结束所经过的时间）；句意是手术持续了大约四个小时。

senses.title: Length of time
senses.definition: the length of time that something continues or is expected to continue
senses.definitionCN: 某事物持续或预期持续的时间长度
senses.example: The duration of the operation was about four hours.
senses.exampleCN: 手术持续了大约四个小时。
senses.why: Latin durare meant to last, and -ation turns that lasting into a measurable quantity, like sand in a glass.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 durare 意为「持续」，-ation 把这种持续变成一个可测量的量，像玻璃里的沙。

senses.title: A particular period
senses.definition: the period during which something happens, especially a war, a course or a contract
senses.definitionCN: 某事发生的整段时间，尤指战争、课程或合同
senses.example: She stayed for the duration of the conference.
senses.exampleCN: 会议期间她一直留在那里。
senses.why: The measured length also names the stretch of time itself, so duration can mean the whole period covered.
senses.whyCN: 被测量出的长度也可以指那段时间本身，所以 duration 也能表示整个覆盖的时期。

senses.title: Length of a sound
senses.definition: the amount of time a speech sound or musical note is held, used in phonetics and music
senses.definitionCN: 语音或音符被持续的时间，用于语音学与音乐
senses.example: In this language, vowel duration can change the meaning of a word.
senses.exampleCN: 在这种语言里，元音的音长能改变词义。
senses.why: Phonetics borrowed the general word because a held sound is simply a duration that can be measured on a machine.
senses.whyCN: 语音学借用了这个通用词，因为一个被拉长的声音就是一段可以在仪器上量出的时长。

intro.en: Duration comes from Latin duratio, a lasting, which was built on durare, to last, and entered English through French.
intro.cn: duration 来自拉丁语 duratio（持续），由 durare（持续）构成，经由法语进入英语。

items.en: Latin durus meant hard or firm, and from it came the idea of holding out or lasting.
items.cn: 拉丁语 durus 意为「坚硬、结实」，由此产生「撑住、持续」的观念。

items.en: The verb durare meant to last or to endure, and it is the direct root of the whole family.
items.cn: 动词 durare 意为「持续、忍耐」，是整个词族的直接词根。

items.en: The noun duratio named the act or state of lasting, and it is the direct source of duration.
items.cn: 名词 duratio 指「持续」的动作或状态，是 duration 的直接来源。

items.en: A French form of the Latin noun carried it toward English, where the spelling settled as duration.
items.cn: 这个拉丁名词的法语形式把它带向英语，拼写最终固定为 duration。

items.en: The word is recorded in English by the late fourteenth century, first in learned and legal writing.
items.cn: 这个词在十四世纪晚期见于英语，最初用于学术和法律文本。

items.en: Everyday use added for the duration, while phonetics and music kept the technical sense of held length.
items.cn: 日常用法增加了 for the duration 这一短语，语音学与音乐则保留了「拉长的时间」这一技术义。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same Latin lasting root; the near-meaning group separates length, period, term and span by what they measure.
note.cn: 形近组收同一拉丁「持续」词族的词；近义组按所测量的对象区分 length、period、term 与 span。

entries.definition: Able to last a long time; it describes the object, while duration measures the time.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「耐用的、持久的」，描述物体本身，而 duration 测量的是时间。

entries.definition: Throughout or within a period; it began as 'while lasting' from the same verb.
entries.definitionCN: 介词，义为「在……期间」，最初由同一动词的「当其持续时」演变而来。

entries.definition: Relating to duration or length of time; duration plus -al.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「持续时间的、时长的」，由 duration 加 -al 构成。

entries.definition: To last through difficulty or to bear it; related through Latin durus.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「忍受、持续」，经由拉丁语 durus 同源。

entries.definition: The measured extent of time or space; more general than duration.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「长度、时长」，比 duration 更通用。

entries.definition: A stretch of time with a beginning and an end; it can also name an era.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「时期、阶段」，有始有终，也可指一个时代。

entries.definition: A fixed length of time, as of a contract, school year or office; it stresses the limit.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「期限、任期」，强调固定的时限。

entries.definition: The full extent from beginning to end, as of a life or a bridge; it stresses the whole reach.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「跨度、全程」，强调从始到终的整体范围。

normalIntro.en: These hooks tie duration to the Latin verb for lasting and to the image of sand running through a glass.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子把 duration 连到表示「持续」的拉丁动词，以及沙粒流过沙漏的画面。

normal.en: durare is to last; duration is the amount of lasting measured out.
normal.cn: durare 是「持续」，duration 就是量出来的持续长度。

normal.en: The suffix -ation turns the verb into a noun of process and result.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ation 把动词变成表示过程与结果的名词。

normal.en: The same root gives durable, during and endure, so the family all points at time.
normal.cn: 同一词根给出 durable、during 与 endure，这一族都指向时间。

normal.en: For the duration means for the whole time, until the end.
normal.cn: for the duration 意为在整个期间，直到结束。

normal.en: A long vowel has a longer duration than a short one, which is why phonetics uses the word.
normal.cn: 长元音的 duration 比短元音长，所以语音学用这个词。

abstract.en: Picture an hourglass: the amount of sand that has fallen is the duration already spent.
abstract.cn: 想象一只沙漏：已落下的沙量就是已经耗掉的 duration。

abstract.en: Turn the glass over and the same sand becomes a period with a beginning and an end.
abstract.cn: 把沙漏翻转，同一堆沙就变成有始有终的一段时间。

abstract.en: Duration is time made countable, one grain after another.
abstract.cn: duration 是被变得可数的时间，一粒沙接着一粒沙。

examples.en: The duration of the flight is about eleven hours.
examples.cn: 这次飞行的时长约为十一小时。

examples.en: She stayed for the duration of the conference.
examples.cn: 会议期间她一直留在那里。

examples.en: The drug reduces the duration of the illness.
examples.cn: 这种药能缩短病程。

dict_mnemonic.text: dur- 是「持续」，-ation 是名词后缀：duration 就是「持续出来的那段时间」。

root: 来自拉丁语 duratio「持续」，由动词 durare「持续、忍耐」加名词后缀构成，durare 又源于 durus「坚硬的」。经由法语进入英语，十四世纪晚期已有记录；同族词包括 durable、during、endure。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses of duration all measure or name a stretch of time: a length, a whole period, or the held length of a sound.
sensesIntro.cn: duration 的三个义项都在测量或命名一段时间：一个长度、一整段时期，或一个声音被拉长的时长。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: sand running through an hourglass, measuring how long a thing lasts.
core.cn: 核心意象：沙粒流过沙漏，量出某物持续多久。

branches.en: THE MEASURE: the amount of time from start to finish.
branches.cn: 度量线：从开始到结束的时间总量。

branches.en: THE PERIOD: the whole stretch during which an event or contract runs.
branches.cn: 时期线：某一事件或合同持续覆盖的整段时间。

branches.en: THE SOUND: a held vowel or note measured on a machine.
branches.cn: 声音线：在仪器上量出的拉长元音或音符。

branches.en: LENGTH AND PERIOD: one is the number, the other is the stretch it describes.
branches.cn: 长度与时期：一个是数字，另一个是数字所描述的那一段。

branches.en: SMALL AND LARGE SCALES: a war lasts years, a vowel lasts milliseconds, and both are durations.
branches.cn: 大小尺度：战争持续数年，元音持续毫秒，两者都是 duration。

intro.en: Duration is a Latin-derived noun: a verb root plus -ation, with relatives built on -able and -al.
intro.cn: duration 是源自拉丁语的名词：动词词根加 -ation，亲属词则由 -able 与 -al 构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin durus, durare, duratio and durabilis are all recorded, so only the deeper Indo-European root is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 durus、durare、duratio、durabilis 均有记录，只有更早的印欧语词根属于重构。

items.example: The root supplies the sense of holding out.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供「撑住」的含义。

items.example: The verb is the direct source of the noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是名词的直接来源。
它把 durare 变成 duratio。

items.example: It appears in the English ending -tion.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在英语的 -tion 词尾中。

items.example: It forms during from the old verb dure.
items.exampleCN: 它由旧动词 dure 构成 during。

derivatives.zh: 与 duration 同出拉丁语 durare，义为「耐用的；持久的」
由本词加形容词后缀 -al 构成，义为「持续时间的；时长的」
由本词同源词加 -ive 构成，义为「持续性的（语法术语）」

definition_zh: 黄昏；薄暮；暮色；昏暗
definition_en: the time when day is ending and night is beginning, the dim light of that time, or a dark shadowy state
core_image: 山脊上的颜色一点点褪去，天边只剩一层薄薄的灰蓝
scene: 山脊上的颜色一点点褪去，鸟群开始向林中飞去。The birds returned to the trees at dusk.
sceneCN: 这里 dusk 是「黄昏」（第 1 个义项：白昼将尽、夜晚初临的时刻）；句意是黄昏时鸟群飞回了林中。

senses.title: The time when day ends
senses.definition: the time of day when the sun has set or is setting and night is beginning
senses.definitionCN: 太阳已落或正在落下、夜晚开始的时刻
senses.example: The birds returned to the trees at dusk.
senses.exampleCN: 黄昏时鸟群飞回了林中。
senses.why: Dusk began as an adjective for darkness; the noun then named the hour when that darkness first settles.
senses.whyCN: dusk 最初是表示「昏暗」的形容词，名词随后命名那片昏暗初次落下的时刻。

senses.title: The dim light of that hour
senses.definition: the soft, dim light seen in the sky just after sunset or just before night
senses.definitionCN: 日落后或入夜前天空中那种柔和而暗淡的光
senses.example: The dusk light made the road hard to see.
senses.exampleCN: 暮色让路很难看清。
senses.why: The hour and the light it contains are named together, so dusk can mean the glow as well as the time.
senses.whyCN: 那个时辰与它包含的光被一起命名，所以 dusk 既可指时刻，也可指那层光。

senses.title: A dark, shadowy state
senses.definition: a state of darkness or gloom, used mainly in literary writing
senses.definitionCN: 昏暗或阴郁的状态，主要用于书面文学
senses.example: The room lay in the dusk of drawn curtains.
senses.exampleCN: 房间笼罩在拉上窗帘后的幽暗里。
senses.why: Literature extends the evening image indoors: any half-dark place can be described as being in dusk.
senses.whyCN: 文学把黄昏的意象移到室内：任何半暗的地方都可以说处在 dusk 里。

intro.en: Dusk is an Old English word for dark or swarthy; the modern noun for twilight developed later from that adjective.
intro.cn: dusk 是古英语中表示「昏暗、黝黑」的词；现代表示「暮色」的名词义是后来从这个形容词发展出来的。

items.en: Old English dox or dusce described something dark, swarthy or shadowy, especially colour.
items.cn: 古英语 dox 或 dusce 形容昏暗、黝黑或阴影般的，尤其指颜色。

items.en: Middle English kept the adjective sense of dark and dim, applied to light and to surfaces.
items.cn: 中古英语保留了「昏暗、暗淡」的形容词义，用于光和表面。

items.en: The noun dusk for the twilight hour is recorded in the seventeenth century, growing from the adjective.
items.cn: 表示黄昏时刻的名词 dusk 在十七世纪有记录，是从形容词发展来的。

items.en: Literary writing extended dusk to any shadowy half-light, including indoor gloom.
items.cn: 文学写作把 dusk 扩展到任何幽暗的半光，包括室内的阴郁。

items.en: At dusk, dusk falls and from dusk till dawn fixed the word in everyday time expressions.
items.cn: at dusk、dusk falls 与 from dusk till dawn 把这个词固定在日常时间表达里。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms built on dusk and one near-spelling word; the near-meaning group separates twilight, sunset and nightfall by exact time.
note.cn: 形近组收由 dusk 构成的词形和一个拼写相近的词；近义组按确切时段区分 twilight、sunset 与 nightfall。

entries.definition: Dark or dim, often with a soft or slightly sad tone; dusk plus -y.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「昏暗的、暮色的」，常带柔和或微带忧伤的语气，由 dusk 加 -y 构成。

entries.definition: The quality of being dark or dim; dusky plus -ness.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「昏暗、幽暗」，由 dusky 加 -ness 构成。

entries.definition: Slightly dark or dim; dusk plus the softening suffix -ish.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「微暗的、略带暮色的」，由 dusk 加弱化后缀 -ish 构成。

entries.definition: Fine dry particles of earth; it looks close to dusk but is a different noun.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「灰尘」，拼写与 dusk 接近，却是另一个名词。

entries.definition: The soft light between sunset and darkness, or between darkness and sunrise; wider than dusk.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「暮光、曙光」，指日落到黑暗之间或黑暗到日出之间的柔光，范围比 dusk 更宽。

entries.definition: The moment the sun disappears below the horizon; it marks the start of dusk.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「日落」，指太阳沉到地平线以下的时刻，是黄昏的开端。

entries.definition: The moment night begins; later and darker than dusk.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「入夜」，指夜晚开始的时刻，比黄昏更晚、更暗。

entries.definition: The later part of the day, from late afternoon to night; much broader than dusk.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「傍晚、晚上」，指一天的后半段，范围比 dusk 宽得多。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from the old adjective for dark and then narrow it to the hour when darkness first falls.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子从表示「昏暗」的古老形容词出发，再收窄到黑暗最初落下的那个时辰。

normal.en: Dusk first meant dark as an adjective, then became the name of the darkening hour.
normal.cn: dusk 最初作形容词表示「昏暗」，后来变成那个渐渐变暗的时辰的名字。

normal.en: At dusk is the fixed phrase; dusk falls is the picture of the light giving way.
normal.cn: at dusk 是固定说法，dusk falls 是光线让位的画面。

normal.en: Dusk sits between sunset and nightfall: not yet night, no longer day.
normal.cn: dusk 位于日落与入夜之间：还不是夜，也不再是白天。

normal.en: Dusky is the adjective, duskiness the noun: the family keeps the dim light.
normal.cn: dusky 是形容词，duskiness 是名词，这一族都保留着那层昏暗的光。

normal.en: From dusk till dawn covers the whole night between two soft lights.
normal.cn: from dusk till dawn 覆盖两片柔光之间的整个夜晚。

abstract.en: Picture a hillside where colour drains away and only a grey-blue band remains.
abstract.cn: 想象一面山坡，颜色一点点褪去，只剩一条灰蓝的带子。

abstract.en: The same band appears indoors behind drawn curtains, as a room fills with half-light.
abstract.cn: 同一条带子又出现在拉上窗帘的室内，房间被半光填满。

abstract.en: Dusk is the seam between day and night, where neither one fully holds.
abstract.cn: dusk 是白昼与夜晚之间的接缝，两边都还未完全占住。

examples.en: The birds returned to the trees at dusk.
examples.cn: 黄昏时鸟群飞回了林中。

examples.en: By dusk the market had emptied.
examples.cn: 到黄昏时，市场已经空了。

examples.en: The dusk light made the road hard to see.
examples.cn: 暮色让路很难看清。

dict_mnemonic.text: dusk 是太阳落下后那层灰蓝的薄光：白天用尽，夜晚还没完全接手。

root: 古英语 dox 或 dusce 形容「昏暗、黝黑」，中古英语保留形容词义；十七世纪起名词 dusk 指黄昏时刻，十八至十九世纪文学又把它扩展到任何幽暗的半光。与 dust 拼写相近但来源不同。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses of dusk move from the hour, to the light inside it, to any shadowy half-dark.
sensesIntro.cn: dusk 的三个义项从那个时辰，移到时辰里的光，再移到任何幽暗的半黑。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hillside losing its colour as a thin grey-blue band remains.
core.cn: 核心意象：山坡褪去颜色，只剩一条薄薄的灰蓝。

branches.en: THE HOUR: the moment when day ends and night begins.
branches.cn: 时辰线：白昼结束、夜晚开始的时刻。

branches.en: THE LIGHT: the soft dim glow left in the sky at that hour.
branches.cn: 光线线：那个时辰天空里留下的柔和暗光。

branches.en: THE GLOOM: any shadowy half-dark, especially indoors in literature.
branches.cn: 幽暗线：任何阴影般的半黑，尤指文学中的室内。

branches.en: TIME AND GLOW: the word names both the hour and what fills it.
branches.cn: 时辰与光：这个词同时命名那个时刻和充满它的光。

branches.en: FROM SKY TO ROOM: the same dim light is carried indoors as gloom.
branches.cn: 从天空到室内：同一种暗光被带进屋里，成为幽暗。

intro.en: Dusk is a native English word; English adds -y, -ness and -ish, and fixed phrases carry most of its use.
intro.cn: dusk 是本族语英语词；英语加 -y、-ness、-ish，而它的用法多由固定短语承担。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source; Latin crepusculum, twilight, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 crepusculum（暮色）只是语义上的对应。

items.example: The word began as an adjective and became a noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个词从形容词开始，后来成为名词。
它出现在 dusk falls 中。

items.example: It appears in from dusk till dawn.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 from dusk till dawn 中。
它出现在 at dusk 中。
它出现在 by dusk 中。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加形容词后缀 -y 构成，义为「昏暗的；暮色的」
由 dusky 加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「昏暗；暮色」
由本词加 -ish 构成，义为「略带暮色的；微暗的」

definition_zh: n. 侏儒症；矮小症；（植物）矮化
definition_en: a medical condition in which a person, animal or plant grows much less than the normal size for its kind
core_image: 诊室墙上贴着生长曲线图，孩子的身高线远远落在同龄人区间下方；X 光片上长骨末端提前闭合；花盆里一株本该长到一人高的玉米只到膝头，节间挤成一团
scene: 诊室墙上贴着生长曲线图，孩子的身高线远远落在同龄人曲线下方，医生用笔尖点了点那条线。The chart confirmed a diagnosis of dwarfism.
sceneCN: 这里 dwarfism 指「一个人生长远低于常人的医学状况」（第 1 个义项：侏儒症）；句意是那张曲线图确认了侏儒症的诊断。图中可辨识物件：生长曲线图、落在区间下方的线、医生的笔尖。

pos.zh: 侏儒症；矮小症；（植物）矮化

derivatives.zh: 矮人；使显得矮小；矮小的

senses.title: A medical condition
senses.definition: a medical condition in which a person grows much less than usual
senses.definitionCN: （名词）一个人生长远低于常人的医学状况
senses.example: The chart confirmed a diagnosis of dwarfism.
senses.exampleCN: 那张曲线图确认了侏儒症的诊断。
senses.why: A growth chart on a clinic wall shows one line far below the band of the same age.
senses.whyCN: 诊室墙上的生长曲线图里，一条线远远落在同龄人的区间下方。

senses.title: Stunted body size
senses.definition: the state of being much smaller than the normal size for a species
senses.definitionCN: （名词）远小于该物种正常体型的状态
senses.example: In the herd, dwarfism appeared in two calves born that spring.
senses.exampleCN: 那年春天出生的两头小牛身上出现了矮小症。
senses.why: An X-ray shows the ends of the long bones closed long before they should have.
senses.whyCN: 一张 X 光片显示长骨末端早在应闭合之前就闭合了。

senses.title: Stunted plants
senses.definition: a condition in which a plant stays far below its normal height
senses.definitionCN: （名词）植株远低于正常高度的状态
senses.example: The virus causes dwarfism in maize, so the stems never reach knee height.
senses.exampleCN: 这种病毒引起玉米矮化，茎秆永远长不到膝头。
senses.why: A maize plant in a pot stops at knee height with its joints crowded into a bunch.
senses.whyCN: 花盆里一株玉米停在膝头高度，节间挤成一团。

intro.en: Dwarfism is dwarf plus -ism, the ending that names a condition or a doctrine; dwarf itself is an Old English word for a small mountain being, and medicine borrowed it for a body that stops growing early.
intro.cn: dwarfism 由 dwarf 加 -ism 构成，这个后缀指称某种状况或学说；dwarf 本身是古英语中指山中矮小生物的词，医学借它来指过早停止生长的身体。

items.en: Old English dweorg names a small supernatural being of the mountains.
items.cn: 古英语 dweorg 指山中的小型超自然生物。

items.en: A Germanic root links the word to Old Norse and Old High German names for the same being.
items.cn: 一个日耳曼语词根把它与古诺斯语、古高地德语中同一生物的名称联系起来。

items.en: Middle English dwarf keeps the sense of a very small person.
items.cn: 中古英语 dwarf 保留「极矮小的人」这一义。

items.en: The noun dwarfism is formed with -ism for the medical condition.
items.cn: 名词 dwarfism 用 -ism 构成，指这种医学状况。

items.en: Dwarfism is classified by cause, from bone growth to hormone shortage.
items.cn: dwarfism 按成因分类，从骨骼生长到激素不足。

items.en: The term also covers stunted growth in animals and plants.
items.cn: 这个术语也涵盖动物与植物的发育矮小。

note.en: Dwarfism shares the condition ending -ism with autism and albinism, while its neighbours name particular causes of stunted growth.
note.cn: dwarfism 与 autism、albinism 共用表状况的后缀 -ism，而它的近义词则指发育受阻的具体成因。

entries.definition: unnaturally small, or like a dwarf
entries.definitionCN: 异常矮小的；像矮人的

entries.definition: a developmental condition affecting communication and social interaction
entries.definitionCN: 影响沟通与社交的发育状况

entries.definition: a condition in which the body produces little or no pigment
entries.definitionCN: 身体极少或不产生色素的状况

entries.definition: a genetic condition in which the long bones grow very little
entries.definitionCN: 长骨生长极少的遗传状况

entries.definition: the slowing of growth caused by poor nutrition or illness
entries.definitionCN: 因营养不良或疾病造成的生长迟缓

entries.definition: a condition in which the pituitary gland produces too little hormone
entries.definitionCN: 垂体产生激素过少的状况

normalIntro.en: Five pictures of growth stopped short.
normalIntro.cn: 五个「生长提前停住」的画面。

dict_mnemonic.text: dwarfism ＝ dwarf（矮人；古英语 dweorg，山中的小生物）＋ -ism（表某种状况）＝「矮小这种状况」。医学上它指生长远落后于同龄：最常见的原因是 achondroplasia（软骨发育不全），其次是垂体激素不足。-ism 家族还有 autism、albinism，都是「某种状况」。植物学里 dwarfism 指「矮化」，如病毒引起的玉米矮化。注意 dwarf 也可作动词「使显得矮小」。

root: 古英语 dweorg（山中矮小生物）→ dwarf（矮人）＋ -ism（状况）→ dwarfism（侏儒症；矮化）

intro.en: Dwell began as a verb of delay: Old English dwellan meant to lead astray or hold back. The idea of being held in one place softened into staying, then into living there, and finally into the mind staying on one thought.

dict_mnemonic.text: dwell 的古英语 dwellan 本义是「引入歧途、拖住」——被拖住就是「停留」，停留久了就是「居住」。所以 dwell in the stone houses 是「住在石屋里」（偏书面），而 dwell on the past 是「心思停在过去出不来」，即「老想着、耿耿于怀」。名词 dwell 在机械里指「停留时间」，如活塞在上止点的短暂停顿。派生词 dweller 是「居民」，dwelling 是「住所」。过去式常用 dwelt。

root: 古英语 dwellan（引入歧途、拖住）→ 古诺斯语 dvelja（停留）→ 中古英语 dwellen（居住）→ dwell on（细想）

core.cn: 核心意象：公寓门厅里一整墙铜名牌，每个名字后面都有一扇小门

branches.en: A person who lives in a place.
branches.cn: 住在某个地方的人。

branches.en: An animal that lives in a habitat.
branches.cn: 生活在某类环境中的动物。

branches.en: A label joined to a place word.
branches.cn: 接在地点词之后的标签。

branches.en: Both are the one who stays there.

branches.en: The habitat becomes a name for the life.

intro.en: Dweller is dwell plus the agent ending -er; in- builds indwell, while Latin habit-, sid- and occup- give the neighbouring words for living somewhere.
intro.cn: dweller 由 dwell 加表人的后缀 -er 组成；in- 造出 indwell，而拉丁语 habit-、sid- 与 occup- 给出指称「住在某地」的近义词。

latinIntro.en: Latin habitare means to dwell, sedere to sit, occupare to seize and domus a house; cavus means hollow.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 habitare 意为居住，sedere 意为坐，occupare 意为占据，domus 意为房屋；cavus 意为空的。

definition_zh: v. 逐渐变小；缩小；减少；衰退
definition_en: to become gradually smaller, fewer or weaker, often until only a little is left
core_image: 储物架从十二袋粮食变成两袋，中间空出一格格；水池石阶上留着一圈圈旧水位痕，最上面那圈干得发白；蜡烛火苗缩成一粒蓝珠；满场听众散到只剩路灯下三个人
scene: 水池边石阶上留着一圈圈旧水位痕，最上面那一圈已经干得发白，露出浅浅的盐渍。The water level continued to dwindle through the dry summer.
sceneCN: 这里 dwindle 指「数量或体积一点点变少」（第 1 个义项：逐渐减少）；句意是整个干旱的夏天水位持续下降。图中可辨识物件：石阶、一圈圈旧水位痕、发白的盐渍。

pos.zh: 逐渐变小；缩小；减少；衰退

senses.title: To become fewer or less
senses.definition: to become gradually fewer or less in amount
senses.definitionCN: （动词）数量或份量一点点变少
senses.example: Supplies began to dwindle after the third week of the siege.
senses.exampleCN: 围城进入第三周后，补给开始逐渐减少。
senses.why: A store shelf that held twelve sacks now holds two, with empty gaps between them.
senses.whyCN: 原本放着十二袋粮食的储物架如今只剩两袋，中间空出一格格。

senses.title: To become weaker or fainter
senses.definition: to become gradually weaker, fainter or less strong
senses.definitionCN: （动词）力量、声音或光亮一点点变弱
senses.example: Her voice dwindled to a whisper as the lights went out.
senses.exampleCN: 灯灭之后，她的声音渐渐弱成耳语。
senses.why: A candle flame shrinks to a blue bead while the pool of wax spreads wider.
senses.whyCN: 蜡烛火苗缩成一粒蓝珠，蜡油却摊得更宽。

senses.title: To shrink to a small remainder
senses.definition: to shrink until only a small part is left
senses.definitionCN: （动词）一直缩到只剩下一小部分
senses.example: The crowd dwindled to a handful of people waiting in the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 人群渐渐散去，只剩寥寥几个人在雨里等着。
senses.why: A full square of listeners empties until three figures stand under one lamp.
senses.whyCN: 挤满听众的广场空了下来，最后只剩三个人站在一盏路灯下。

intro.en: Dwindle is dwine plus -le, an ending that turns a verb into a repeated small action; dwine goes back to Old English dwinan, to waste away, so the word carries the picture of losing a little again and again.
intro.cn: dwindle 由 dwine 加 -le 构成，这个后缀把动词变成反复发生的小幅动作；dwine 源自古英语 dwinan「消瘦」，所以这个词自带「一次次少掉一点」的画面。

items.en: Old English dwinan meant to waste away or to pine.
items.cn: 古英语 dwinan 意为消瘦、憔悴。

items.en: Middle English dwinen kept the sense of fading little by little.
items.cn: 中古英语 dwinen 保留「一点点消退」这一义。

items.en: The ending -le was added to make a verb of repeated small shrinking.
items.cn: 加上后缀 -le，构成表示反复小幅缩减的动词。

items.en: Early modern writers used dwindle for fortunes and bodies wasting away.
items.cn: 近代早期作家用 dwindle 指家产与身体的耗损。

items.en: Dwindle spread to hopes, crowds and supplies as well as physical size.
items.cn: dwindle 扩展到希望、人群与补给，不只指体积。

items.en: Today dwindle is the common word for a slow steady falling away.
items.cn: 今天 dwindle 是表示缓慢持续减少的常用词。

note.en: Dwindle and swindle differ by one letter but share nothing in meaning; the -le ending marks a repeated small action, as in sparkle and crackle.
note.cn: dwindle 与 swindle 只差一个字母，意思却毫不相干；后缀 -le 表示反复的小幅动作，sparkle、crackle 也是这一类。

entries.definitionCN: 诈骗；骗取

entries.definition: to waste away or pine, an older word behind this one

entries.definitionCN: 日渐减少的

entries.definitionCN: 收缩；变小

dict_mnemonic.text: dwindle ＝ dwine（消瘦，古英语 dwinan）＋ -le（反复的小幅动作）＝「一次次少掉一点」。-le 这一族还有 sparkle（一闪一闪）、crackle（噼啪作响）、wriggle（扭来扭去），都是「小动作重复发生」。注意 dwindle 是不及物动词：主语自己变小，说 supplies dwindle，不能说 dwindle the supplies。常接 to 表示终点：dwindle to nothing／to a handful。形近词 swindle 是「诈骗」，只差一个字母，别认混。近义词 diminish 可及物可不及物，shrink 偏体积收缩，wane 偏月亮与势力的衰退。

root: 古英语 dwinan（消瘦）→ 中古英语 dwinen → dwine ＋ -le（反复小幅动作）→ dwindle（逐渐变小）

sensesIntro.en: Losing a little at a time: a shelf with empty gaps where sacks stood, a flame shrunk to a blue bead and a square left with three figures under one lamp.
sensesIntro.cn: 一点点少下去：原本堆着粮袋的架子空出一格格、火苗缩成一粒蓝珠，以及只剩路灯下三个人的广场。

branches.en: Amount and number fall slowly.
branches.cn: 份量与数量缓慢下降。

branches.en: Strength, sound and light grow faint.
branches.cn: 力量、声音与光亮变弱。

branches.en: Only a small remainder is left.
branches.cn: 只剩下一小部分。

branches.en: The falling ends in a handful.
branches.cn: 减少的终点是寥寥几个。

branches.en: Fading until almost nothing remains.
branches.cn: 一直淡到几乎不剩。

intro.cn: dwindle 由 dwine 加表反复的后缀 -le 组成；dis- 与 min- 造出 diminish，wan- 给出 wane，德语 schwind- 则给出形近词 swindle。

latinIntro.en: Latin minuere means to make less, minor smaller and minutus very small; these give diminish and minute.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 minuere 意为使变少，minor 意为更小，minutus 意为极小；它们给出 diminish 与 minute。

definition_zh: 染料；染色；染上颜色
definition_en: a substance used to give colour to cloth, hair or other materials, to colour something with it, or to give a deep lasting colour
core_image: 一块白布浸进深蓝色的染缸，提起来时颜色已经吃进纤维
scene: 作坊里一口大染缸冒着热气，白布被慢慢浸下去。The cloth was soaked in a blue dye.
sceneCN: 这里 dye 是「染料」（第 1 个义项：给织物上色的物质）；句意是那块布被浸在蓝色染料里。

senses.title: A colouring substance
senses.definition: a natural or chemical substance used to give colour to cloth, hair or other materials
senses.definitionCN: 用来给布料、头发或其他材料上色的天然或化学物质
senses.example: The cloth was soaked in a blue dye.
senses.exampleCN: 那块布被浸在蓝色染料里。
senses.why: This is the concrete core: a substance whose only job is to transfer colour into a material.
senses.whyCN: 这是具体的核心：一种唯一任务就是把颜色送进材料里的物质。

senses.title: To colour with a dye
senses.definition: to give something a colour by putting it into a dye or applying dye to it
senses.definitionCN: 把某物放进染液或把染料涂上去，使其带有颜色
senses.example: She dyed her coat dark green.
senses.exampleCN: 她把外套染成了深绿色。
senses.why: The verb is the noun in action: the substance enters the material and changes its colour.
senses.whyCN: 动词就是名词在动作中：物质进入材料，改变了它的颜色。

senses.title: To colour deeply or lastingly
senses.definition: to give something a strong or lasting colour, often used of light or of a figurative change
senses.definitionCN: 给某物强烈的或持久的颜色，常用于光线或比喻性的变化
senses.example: The sunset dyed the sky orange.
senses.exampleCN: 落日把天空染成了橙色。
senses.why: Once a dye is fixed, the colour will not wash out, so the verb extends to any deep and lasting tint.
senses.whyCN: 染料一旦固定，颜色就洗不掉，于是这个动词扩展到任何浓重而持久的着色。

intro.en: Dye is a native Old English word for colour and for the act of colouring, later narrowed to the substance and its use.
intro.cn: dye 是本族语古英语词，原指颜色与上色的动作，后来收窄为染料及其使用。

items.en: A Germanic noun and verb for colouring are reconstructed, though the exact forms and their deeper origin are uncertain.
items.cn: 日耳曼语中被重构出表示「上色」的名词与动词，但其确切形式与更早来源不确定。

items.en: Old English had a noun for colour or dye and a verb meaning to colour, both from the same family.
items.cn: 古英语有表示「颜色、染料」的名词，也有表示「上色」的动词，二者同属一族。

items.en: Middle English kept the noun for the substance and the verb for the action, and the spelling moved toward dye.
items.cn: 中古英语保留了表示物质的名词和表示动作的动词，拼写逐渐走向 dye。

items.en: Dyeing became a major trade, and dye, dyer and dyestuff fixed the workshop vocabulary.
items.cn: 染色在十六世纪成为重要行业，dye、dyer、dyestuff 固定了作坊里的词汇。

items.en: The figurative sense of colouring light or a mood appears alongside the industrial sense.
items.cn: 给光线或情绪「染色」的比喻义与工业义同时存在。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms built on dye and one dangerous near-spelling; the near-meaning group separates colouring verbs by strength and method.
note.cn: 形近组收由 dye 构成的词形和一个易混拼写；近义组按强度与方法区分几个着色动词。

entries.definition: A person whose trade is dyeing cloth; dye plus -er.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「染工」，由 dye 加 -er 构成。

entries.definition: Any substance used as a dye; dye plus stuff.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「染料、着色剂」，由 dye 加 stuff 构成。

entries.definition: The process of colouring cloth; spelled with e to distinguish it from dying.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「染色工艺」，保留 e 是为了与 dying 区分。

entries.definition: The present participle of die; it sounds the same as dyeing but has no colour in it.
entries.definitionCN: die 的现在分词，与 dyeing 同音，却与颜色无关。

entries.definition: To give colour to something; the general verb, usable for paint, dye or light.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「给……上色」，通用词，可指颜料、染料或光。

entries.definition: To leave a mark or colour that is hard to remove, often accidentally.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「弄脏、染上痕迹」，常指意外留下难去的颜色。

entries.definition: To give a slight colour to something; softer and lighter than dye.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「给……淡淡上色」，比 dye 更轻更浅。

entries.definition: A dry colouring matter used in paint; a material rather than the action.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「颜料」，是涂料中的干性着色物质，指材料而非动作。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow the colour from the vat into the fibre and then into the sky at sunset.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子跟着颜色从染缸进入纤维，再进入落日的天空。

normal.en: Dye is the substance; to dye is to put that substance into a material.
normal.cn: dye 是物质，to dye 是把这种物质送进材料。

normal.en: A dyer works with dye, and a dyestuff is any material that dyes.
normal.cn: dyer 与 dye 打交道，dyestuff 是任何能染色的材料。

normal.en: Dyeing keeps the e; dying from die does not, so the spelling marks the difference.
normal.cn: dyeing 保留 e，来自 die 的 dying 不留，拼写标出了区别。

normal.en: A blue dye in a vat can turn a whole bolt of cloth blue.
normal.cn: 染缸里的一缸蓝色染料能把整匹布染蓝。

normal.en: Sunset dyeing the sky is the same image, with light as the dye.
normal.cn: 落日染天空是同一个意象，只是光成了染料。

abstract.en: Picture white cloth disappearing into dark blue liquid and coming out changed.
abstract.cn: 想象白布没入深蓝的液体，再出来时已经变了颜色。

abstract.en: The same liquid, thinner, could be a tint; the same mark, accidental, could be a stain.
abstract.cn: 同样的液体淡一些就是 tint；同样的痕迹若是意外留下，就是 stain。

abstract.en: Dye is colour deciding to stay rather than sit on the surface.
abstract.cn: dye 是颜色决定留下来，而不是停在表面。

examples.cn: 那块布被浸在蓝色染料里。

examples.en: She dyed her coat dark green.
examples.cn: 她把外套染成了深绿色。

examples.en: The sunset dyed the sky orange.
examples.cn: 落日把天空染成了橙色。

dict_mnemonic.text: dye 是一缸颜色：把布浸进去，颜色就吃进纤维，再也洗不掉。

root: 本族语古英语词，原有表示「颜色、染料」的名词与表示「上色」的动词，中古英语拼写逐渐固定为 dye。十六世纪染色业兴盛，dyer、dyestuff 等词进入作坊词汇。更早的日耳曼语形式与印欧语来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses of dye move from the substance, to the act of applying it, to any deep and lasting colouring.
sensesIntro.cn: dye 的三个义项从染料这一物质，移到施加它的动作，再到任何浓重而持久的着色。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: white cloth sinking into a vat of dark blue liquid.
core.cn: 核心意象：白布沉入一缸深蓝的染液。

branches.en: THE SUBSTANCE: the material whose purpose is to carry colour.
branches.cn: 物质线：以携带颜色为目的的材料。

branches.en: THE BATH: the cloth enters the liquid and comes out changed.
branches.cn: 染缸线：布进入液体，出来时已经变了颜色。

branches.en: THE LASTING TINT: colour that stays, even when the dye is light.
branches.cn: 持久着色线：颜色留了下来，即使染的是光。

branches.en: MATTER AND ACTION: the substance and the act share one name in English.
branches.cn: 物质与动作：物质和动作在英语里共用一个词。

branches.en: FROM CLOTH TO SKY: the same verb colours fabric and evening light.
branches.cn: 从布到天空：同一个动词既染织物，也染暮色。

intro.en: Dye is a native word; English builds dyer, dyestuff and dyeing with ordinary suffixes.
intro.cn: dye 是本族语词；英语用普通后缀构成 dyer、dyestuff 与 dyeing。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin ancestor; Latin tingere, to dye, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁语祖先；拉丁语 tingere（染色）只是语义上的对应。

items.example: The word serves as noun and verb.
items.exampleCN: 这个词兼作名词与动词。

items.meaning: more than one; he or she does

definition_zh: 有活力的；动态的；不断变化的；动力学的
definition_en: full of energy and force, constantly changing or active, relating to motion and forces, or describing an action rather than a state
core_image: 一股看不见的力推着齿轮转动，整个系统都在变
scene: 创业公司的会议室里，白板写满又擦掉，讨论一直没停。She is a dynamic young manager who thrives on change.
sceneCN: 这里 dynamic 是「有活力的」（第 1 个义项：精力充沛、富有推动力）；句意是她是一位在变化中如鱼得水的有活力的年轻经理。

pos.zh: 有活力的；动态的；动力学的

senses.title: Full of energy
senses.definition: full of energy, new ideas and forcefulness, especially of a person or style
senses.definitionCN: 充满精力、新想法与推动力，尤用于人或风格
senses.example: She is a dynamic young manager who thrives on change.
senses.exampleCN: 她是一位在变化中如鱼得水的有活力的年轻经理。
senses.why: Greek dynamis meant power, so a dynamic person is one who visibly carries power into whatever they do.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 dynamis 意为「力量」，所以 dynamic 的人就是明显把力量带进所做之事的人。

senses.title: Constantly changing
senses.definition: constantly changing, developing or moving, as a system, market or situation
senses.definitionCN: 不断变化、发展或运动，如系统、市场或局势
senses.example: The city has a dynamic economy that attracts young workers.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市拥有吸引年轻劳动者的充满活力的经济。
senses.why: A thing in motion cannot be captured in a single still picture, so dynamic marks whatever is still unfolding.
senses.whyCN: 运动中的事物无法被一张静止照片抓住，所以 dynamic 标记一切仍在展开的东西。

senses.title: Relating to forces in motion
senses.definition: relating to the forces that produce motion or change, used in physics and engineering
senses.definitionCN: 与产生运动或变化的力有关，用于物理与工程
senses.example: The engineers studied the dynamic loads on the bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师研究了桥上的动态载荷。
senses.why: This is the technical home of the word: dynamis is power, and dynamics is the study of forces at work.

senses.title: Describing action, in grammar
senses.definition: describing an action or event rather than a state, as a dynamic verb does
senses.definitionCN: 描述动作或事件而非状态，如动态动词
senses.example: In this grammar, run is a dynamic verb and own is a stative one.
senses.exampleCN: 在这套语法里，run 是动态动词，own 是状态动词。
senses.why: Grammar borrowed the word to separate verbs that move from verbs that merely hold a state.
senses.whyCN: 语法学借用了这个词，用来把表示动作的动词与仅仅表示状态的动词分开。

intro.en: Dynamic comes from Greek dynamis, power, through the adjective dynamikos and later Latin and French forms.
intro.cn: dynamic 来自希腊语 dynamis（力量），经由形容词 dynamikos 以及后来的拉丁语、法语形式进入英语。

items.en: Greek dynamis meant power, strength or capacity, and it could also mean a force in nature.
items.cn: 希腊语 dynamis 意为「力量、能力」，也可指自然中的一种力。

items.en: The adjective dynamikos meant powerful or relating to force, and it was used in philosophy and science.
items.cn: 形容词 dynamikos 意为「有力的、与力有关的」，用于哲学与科学。

items.en: Latin borrowed the Greek adjective as dynamicus, keeping its learned and scientific tone.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入这个希腊形容词作 dynamicus，保留了学术与科学的语气。

items.en: French dynamique carried the word into modern European languages, including English.
items.cn: 法语 dynamique 把这个词带入包括英语在内的现代欧洲语言。

items.en: English dynamic is recorded in the nineteenth century, first in physics and then in general description.
items.cn: 英语 dynamic 在十九世纪有记录，先用于物理，再用于一般描述。

items.en: The word now describes lively people, changing markets and moving forces, all from one idea of power.
items.cn: 这个词如今描述有活力的人、变化的市场与运动中的力，全部来自同一个「力量」观念。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same Greek power root; the near-meaning group separates energetic, active and vigorous by what kind of force they show.
note.cn: 形近组收同一希腊「力量」词根的词；近义组按所显现的力量类型区分 energetic、active 与 vigorous。

entries.definition: The study of forces and motion, or the pattern of forces in a situation.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「动力学、动态」，指对力与运动的研究，或局势中的力量格局。

entries.definition: Great energy, drive or forcefulness in a person or system.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「活力、推动力」，指人或系统中的巨大能量。

entries.definition: In a dynamic or energetic way; dynamic plus -ally.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「动态地、有活力地」，由 dynamic 加 -ally 构成。

entries.definition: An explosive; named from the same Greek word for power.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「炸药」，由同一个表示「力量」的希腊词命名。

entries.definition: Full of physical or mental energy; it stresses activity rather than force.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「精力充沛的」，强调活动而非力量。

entries.definition: Doing things, working or moving; neutral and broader than dynamic.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「活跃的、活动的」，中性且比 dynamic 更宽泛。

entries.definition: Strong, healthy and forceful in action; it stresses bodily strength.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「强健有力的」，强调身体力量。

entries.definition: Not moving or changing; the direct opposite of the changing sense of dynamic.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「静止的、静态的」，与 dynamic 的变化义正好相对。

normalIntro.en: These hooks go back to Greek dynamis, power, and follow it into people, markets, physics and grammar.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子回到希腊语 dynamis（力量），再跟着它走进人、市场、物理与语法。

normal.en: dynamis is power, so dynamic means carrying force.
normal.cn: dynamis 是力量，所以 dynamic 就是带着力量。

normal.en: A dynamic person moves things; a dynamic market keeps moving.
normal.cn: dynamic 的人能推动事情，dynamic 的市场一直在动。

normal.en: Dynamics is the science of those forces, and dynamism is the energy itself.
normal.cn: dynamics 是研究这些力的学问，dynamism 则是那股能量本身。

normal.en: Dynamic balance is balance kept while everything is moving.
normal.cn: dynamic balance 是在一切都在动的时候保持的平衡。

normal.en: A dynamic verb shows action, while a stative verb only holds a state.
normal.cn: 动态动词表示动作，状态动词只表示状态。

abstract.en: Picture a gear train turning with no visible hand behind it.
abstract.cn: 想象一组齿轮在转动，背后却看不见任何手。

abstract.en: The same force can be drawn as a person pushing a project, or as a line on a physics diagram.
abstract.cn: 同一股力可以画成一个人推动项目，也可以画成物理图上的一个箭头。

abstract.en: Dynamic is power that refuses to stay still.
abstract.cn: dynamic 是不肯停下来的力量。

examples.en: She is a dynamic young manager who thrives on change.
examples.cn: 她是一位在变化中如鱼得水的有活力的年轻经理。

examples.en: The city has a dynamic economy that attracts young workers.
examples.cn: 这座城市拥有吸引年轻劳动者的充满活力的经济。

examples.en: The engineers studied the dynamic loads on the bridge.
examples.cn: 工程师研究了桥上的动态载荷。

dict_mnemonic.text: dynam- 是「力量」：dynamic 就是身上带力、局面在动、物理里研究力的那个词。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses of dynamic all carry one idea of power: in a person, in a changing system, in physical forces, and in verbs that show action.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a gear train turning under an invisible force.
core.cn: 核心意象：一组齿轮在一股看不见的力下转动。

branches.en: THE PERSON: energy that visibly pushes other people and projects.
branches.cn: 人物线：明显能推动他人与项目的能量。

branches.en: THE SYSTEM: a market or city that keeps changing shape.
branches.cn: 系统线：不断改变形态的市场或城市。

branches.en: THE PHYSICS: forces that produce motion, measured and diagrammed.
branches.cn: 物理线：产生运动的力，被测量并画成图。

branches.en: THE VERB: grammar separates actions from states with the same word.
branches.cn: 动词线：语法用同一个词把动作与状态分开。

branches.en: ONE FORCE AT THREE SCALES: a person, a market and a machine all carry power in motion.
branches.cn: 同一股力的三种尺度：人、市场与机器都在运动中带着力量。

definition_zh: n. 痢疾；细菌性痢疾；阿米巴痢疾
definition_en: an infection of the intestines that causes severe diarrhoea with blood and mucus, spread mainly through contaminated food and water

intro.en: Dysentery is Greek dys- meaning bad plus enteron meaning intestine; the same enteron gives enteric and enteritis, so the whole family names the gut and what goes wrong in it.
intro.cn: dysentery 由希腊语 dys-（坏）加 enteron（肠）构成；同一个 enteron 给出 enteric 与 enteritis，所以整个词族都在指称肠以及肠里出的问题。

items.en: The Greek prefix dys- means bad or difficult.
items.cn: 希腊语前缀 dys- 意为坏、困难。

items.en: Greek enteron means intestine, the root of the whole family.
items.cn: 希腊语 enteron 意为肠，是整个词族的词根。

items.en: Greek dysenteria joined the two parts into a name for the illness.
items.cn: 希腊语 dysenteria 把两部分合成病名。

items.en: Latin borrowed the Greek term unchanged for medical writing.
items.cn: 拉丁语原样借入这个希腊词，用于医学著述。

items.en: Middle English took the word from Latin and Old French.
items.cn: 中古英语从拉丁语与古法语吸收了这个词。

items.en: Medicine separated the bacillary form from the amoebic form.
items.cn: 医学把细菌性与阿米巴性两种痢疾区分开来。

note.en: Dysentery shares the prefix dys- with dysfunction and dyspepsia, and the root enter- with enteric and enteritis; its neighbours name other gut illnesses.
note.cn: dysentery 与 dysfunction、dyspepsia 共用前缀 dys-，与 enteric、enteritis 共用词根 enter-；它的近义词则指称其他肠道疾病。

dict_mnemonic.text: dysentery ＝ dys-（坏、困难）＋ enter-（肠，希腊语 enteron）＋ -ia（疾病）＝「肠子出了坏毛病」。记住 enter- 就记住一串：enteric 肠的、enteritis 肠炎、gastroenteritis 胃肠炎（gastr- 胃）。dys- 家族还有 dysfunction 功能障碍、dyspepsia 消化不良、dyslexia 读写困难。临床上分两型：bacillary dysentery 细菌性（志贺菌，经污染食物与水传播），amoebic dysentery 阿米巴性（原虫，病程更长易复发）。关键特征是带血与黏液的腹泻，普通 diarrhoea 只是稀便，未必带血。

senses.title: Pain during menstruation
senses.definition: pain in the lower abdomen during menstruation
senses.definitionCN: （名词）经期出现的下腹疼痛
senses.example: She was absent from work twice because of dysmenorrhoea.
senses.exampleCN: 她因为痛经两次没去上班。
senses.why: A hot water bag pressed against a lower belly while a calendar shows three days ringed in red.
senses.whyCN: 热水袋压在小腹上，日历上那三天被红笔圈了出来。

senses.title: The primary form
senses.definition: cramping pain with no underlying disease, common in the first years after periods begin
senses.definitionCN: （名词）没有器质性病变的痉挛性疼痛，多见于初潮后头几年
senses.example: Primary dysmenorrhoea usually begins within a year or two of the first period.
senses.exampleCN: 原发性痛经通常在初潮后一两年内开始。
senses.why: A school nurse log with the same three dates marked every month for one young student.
senses.whyCN: 校医记录本上，同一个年轻学生每个月都标着同样的那三天。

senses.title: The secondary form
senses.definition: pain caused by a condition such as endometriosis, often starting later in life
senses.definitionCN: （名词）由子宫内膜异位症等病症引起、往往较晚出现的疼痛
senses.example: Secondary dysmenorrhoea led the doctor to look for endometriosis.

senses.why: An ultrasound screen showing a small cyst beside the ovary with a measuring line across it.

intro.en: Dysmenorrhoea is dys- meaning difficult, men- meaning month and -rrhoea meaning flow; put together the word names a monthly flow that comes with difficulty and pain.
intro.cn: dysmenorrhoea 由 dys-（困难）、men-（月）与 -rrhoea（流）组成；合起来这个词指称「来得艰难而疼痛的每月血流」。

items.en: The Greek prefix dys- means bad or difficult.
items.cn: 希腊语前缀 dys- 意为坏、困难。

items.en: Greek men means month, the same root behind menstrual.
items.cn: 希腊语 men 意为月，与 menstrual 同一词根。

items.en: Greek rhoia means a flow, giving the ending -rrhoea.
items.cn: 希腊语 rhoia 意为流，给出后缀 -rrhoea。

items.en: Medical Latin assembled the parts into a term for painful periods.
items.cn: 医学拉丁语把各部分拼成表示经期疼痛的术语。

items.en: Medicine split the term into a primary and a secondary form.
items.cn: 医学把这个术语分为原发性与继发性两型。

items.en: American writing drops one letter and spells it dysmenorrhea.
items.cn: 美式拼写省去一个字母，写作 dysmenorrhea。

note.en: Dysmenorrhoea shares dys- with dysentery and -rrhoea with diarrhoea, while amenorrhoea and menorrhagia change the prefix to name too little or too much flow.
note.cn: dysmenorrhoea 与 dysentery 共用 dys-，与 diarrhoea 共用 -rrhoea；而 amenorrhoea 与 menorrhagia 换了前缀，分别指经血过少与过多。

dict_mnemonic.text: dysmenorrhoea ＝ dys-（困难、坏）＋ men-（月，希腊语 men）＋ -rrhoea（流，希腊语 rhoia）＝「艰难的每月血流」＝痛经。记住 men- 就记住一串：menstrual 月经的、menstruation 月经、amenorrhoea 闭经（a- 无）、menorrhagia 经血过多。-rrhoea 家族还有 diarrhoea 腹泻（dia- 穿过）。临床分两型：primary 原发性（无器质病变，初潮后一两年起，痉挛样），secondary 继发性（由 endometriosis 子宫内膜异位症等引起，出现较晚）。美式拼写省一个 o：dysmenorrhea。

root: 希腊语 dys-（困难）＋ men（月）＋ rhoia（流）→ 医学拉丁语 dysmenorrhoea → 痛经

definition_zh: n. 营养障碍；营养不良；（组织）变性萎缩
definition_en: a disorder in which a tissue or organ wastes away because it is poorly nourished or genetically defective
core_image: 肌活检切片上肌纤维大小不一，萎缩纤维之间挤进脂肪与浅色结缔组织；男孩两手扒着楼梯扶手往上挪，小腿看着粗却使不上劲；裂隙灯下角膜透明窗上覆着一层灰色网格；营养不良儿童肋骨像搓衣板
scene: 肌活检切片上肌纤维大小不一，萎缩的纤维之间挤进了脂肪与结缔组织，染色深浅斑驳。The biopsy showed a muscular dystrophy.
sceneCN: 这里 dystrophy 指「组织因营养缺陷或基因缺陷而萎缩的病症」（第 1 个义项：组织营养障碍）；句意是活检显示为肌营养不良。图中可辨识物件：活检切片、大小不一的肌纤维、脂肪与结缔组织。

senses.title: Wasting of a tissue
senses.definition: a disorder in which a tissue wastes away from poor nourishment or a genetic defect
senses.definitionCN: （名词）组织因营养不良或基因缺陷而萎缩的病症
senses.example: The biopsy showed a muscular dystrophy.
senses.exampleCN: 活检显示为肌营养不良。
senses.why: A muscle slide where fibres of uneven size sit apart with fat and pale strands between them.
senses.whyCN: 一张肌肉切片上，大小不一的纤维彼此分开，中间夹着脂肪与浅色条索。

senses.title: The inherited muscle disorder
senses.definition: an inherited group of disorders in which muscles weaken and waste over years
senses.definitionCN: （名词）一组遗传性疾病，肌肉在数年间逐渐无力并萎缩
senses.example: Duchenne muscular dystrophy weakens the legs before the arms.
senses.exampleCN: 杜氏肌营养不良先让双腿无力，之后才轮到双臂。
senses.why: A boy climbing a stair rail with both hands while his calf looks large but gives no push.
senses.whyCN: 一个男孩两手扒着楼梯扶手往上挪，小腿看着粗却使不上劲。

senses.title: A disorder named for an organ
senses.definition: a wasting or clouding disorder named for the organ it affects, such as the cornea
senses.definitionCN: （名词）以受累器官命名的萎缩或混浊病症，如角膜
senses.example: Corneal dystrophy laid a fine lattice of cloud across the eye.
senses.exampleCN: 角膜营养不良在眼球上铺了一层细密的混浊网格。
senses.why: A slit lamp view of a cornea with a grey net drawn over the clear window.
senses.whyCN: 裂隙灯下的角膜，透明窗上像被画了一层灰网。

intro.en: Dystrophy is dys- meaning bad plus trophe meaning nourishment, from Greek trephein to feed; the same trophe gives atrophy for no nourishment and hypertrophy for too much.
intro.cn: dystrophy 由 dys-（坏）加 trophe（营养）构成，trophe 源自希腊语 trephein「喂养」；同一个 trophe 给出 atrophy（无营养）与 hypertrophy（营养过度）。

items.en: The Greek prefix dys- means bad or difficult.
items.cn: 希腊语前缀 dys- 意为坏、困难。

items.en: Greek trephein means to nourish or to feed.
items.cn: 希腊语 trephein 意为滋养、喂养。

items.en: Greek trophe means nourishment, the root of the whole family.
items.cn: 希腊语 trophe 意为营养，是整个词族的词根。

items.en: Medicine coined dystrophy for tissue wasting from defective nourishment.
items.cn: 医学造出 dystrophy，指营养缺陷造成的组织萎缩。

items.en: The inherited muscle disorders were grouped under the same name.
items.cn: 遗传性肌肉疾病被归入同一名称之下。

items.en: Dystrophin was named after the disease it fails to protect.
items.cn: 抗肌萎缩蛋白因它未能保护的疾病而得名。

note.en: Dystrophy, atrophy and hypertrophy share the root trophe and differ only in the prefix: bad, without or over; the neighbours name wasting from other causes.
note.cn: dystrophy、atrophy 与 hypertrophy 共用词根 trophe，只差前缀：坏、无、过度；近义词则指称其他原因造成的萎缩。

dict_mnemonic.text: dystrophy ＝ dys-（坏）＋ troph-（营养，希腊语 trophe，源自 trephein 喂养）＋ -y（状态）＝「营养坏了的状态」。同根三兄弟只差前缀：a-（无）→ atrophy 萎缩（不用就退化）；hyper-（过度）→ hypertrophy 肥大（练过头就变大）；dys-（坏）→ dystrophy 营养障碍（供养本身出了问题）。最常见的是 muscular dystrophy 肌营养不良，其中 Duchenne 型因缺少 dystrophin（抗肌萎缩蛋白）而发病，蛋白名正是从病名来的。此外还有 corneal dystrophy 角膜营养不良、retinal dystrophy 视网膜营养不良。注意与 malnutrition 区分：后者是吃不够，前者是组织自身利用不了营养。

root: 希腊语 dys-（坏）＋ trophe（营养，源自 trephein 喂养）→ dystrophy（营养障碍）
